title: OpenAI Brings GPT-6.2 to ChatGPT's Chat Tab
dek: A chat-tuned GPT-6.2 Sol replaces GPT-6 for paying ChatGPT users.

facts.label: Global rollout began for paid plans

caption:
Your ChatGPT just got a new brain, and you didn't have to touch a setting. 🧠

OpenAI is rolling out GPT-6.2 in ChatGPT's everyday Chat tab, replacing GPT-6 for Plus, Pro, Business and Enterprise users. It's a version of GPT-6.2 Sol tuned for conversation, and OpenAI says it handles detailed instructions, web searches and shared images more reliably. On OpenAI's own tests, image understanding jumped from 47.4% to 71.7%.

There's also a safety angle: OpenAI reports big gains on teen safety evaluations covering emotional reliance, disordered eating and age-restricted goods. ChatGPT Work and Codex aren't changing, and Enterprise access depends on admins.

We're tracking the full GPT-6.2 rollout at AI Parabellum. Remember these are internal benchmarks, so the real test is how it answers your questions.

Screenshots, charts and photos should land better in ChatGPT now. GPT-6.2 is replacing GPT-6 in the Chat tab for paying users, with OpenAI claiming a 24+ point jump in image understanding.

It also promises sharper instruction following and smarter web research, though all numbers come from OpenAI's own tests.
